issue.title: Rename SASE Background Tasks to Procs
issue.description: SASE's durable background-execution feature is named **Proc** end to end — Rust wire types and bindings, the `sase.procs` Python package, the `sase proc` CLI (with `task` kept as a legacy alias), the ACE Procs tab and proc indicator, the `procs.history_limit` config key, the `~/.sase/procs/procs.jsonl` store, docs, memory, skills, and the project glossary — while task beads, asyncio/Textual worker tasks, and the Muse `task.lifecycle.*` provider protocol keep the word "task" untouched.

issue.title: Rename the Rust background-task core to procs
issue.description: core: rename `crates/sase_core/src/tasks/` to `procs/` in ../sase-core, rename the wire structs and the `task_id` field to `Proc*`/`proc_id`, bump the wire schema to 2 while still deserializing legacy `task_id` records, and expose canonical `read_procs_snapshot`/`append_proc`/`update_proc`/`prune_procs` PyO3 bindings alongside the existing legacy binding names.

issue.title: Move the Python package to sase.procs and migrate on-disk state and config
issue.description: store: `git mv src/sase/tasks src/sase/procs`, rename `BackgroundTask` to `Proc` and `task_id` to `proc_id` throughout, move the store to `~/.sase/procs/procs.jsonl` with a marker-guarded one-shot migration, rename the `tasks.history_limit` config key to `procs.history_limit` with the legacy key still honored, and update `tools/validate_sase_core_rs` plus the monitor cross-references.

issue.title: Rename the sase task CLI command tree to sase proc
issue.description: cli: rename `sase task` to `sase proc` with `task` registered as a legacy alias and facade shim modules, rename the parser/handler/render modules and the `--json` envelope key, and update the CLI help text, tests, and `docs/cli.md`.

issue.title: Rename the TUI tracked-task runtime to procs
issue.description: tui-runtime: rename `task_queue.py`, `task_mirror.py`, `task_subprocess.py`, `task_actions.py`, `widgets/task_indicator.py`, and the `_*_tasks.py` action mixins to their proc spellings, rename `TaskQueue`/`TaskMirror`/`TaskReporter`/ `TrackedTask*`/`_submit_tracked_task` and every call site, without changing displayed text.

issue.title: Rename the ACE Tasks pane and Admin Center tab identifier to procs
issue.description: tui-pane: rename the `tasks_pane*` and `tasks_store_rows` modules and `TasksPane` to their proc spellings, move the Admin Center tab identifier from `tasks` to `procs` with persisted-state migration, and rename the `#tasks-*` DOM ids and their `styles.tcss` selectors, without changing displayed text.

issue.title: Flip user-visible Task text to Proc and refresh snapshots
issue.description: labels: change every displayed string that names this feature — Admin Center tab label, pane title and hints, command palette entries, quit-confirm copy, status messages, CLI help — from Task to Proc, then regenerate the affected text and PNG snapshot goldens.

issue.title: Rewrite documentation, memory, skills, and the glossary
issue.description: docs: rewrite the background-task sections of docs/ace.md, cli.md, configuration.md, integrations.md, beads.md, sdd.md, notifications.md, plugins.md, monitors.md, and INSTALL.md, update `sase/memory/tui_perf.md` and the `sase_monitor` skill, add a `Proc` glossary entry to `sase/sase.yml`, and run `sase memory init`.

issue.title: Verify the migration and land the epic
issue.description: land: run the exhaustive verification lane over the combined tree, sweep for residual background-task spellings, confirm no emitter writes `task_id` or `~/.sase/tasks` again, and land the epic.

Representative error: 'ValueError: task wire schema mismatch: got 2, expected 1' from src/sase/tasks/models.py:_require_schema via src/sase/tasks/store.py:85. Reproduced on clean master (d9c685e86, verified via git stash), so it is not any one agent's diff. sase-lh.2 closes the gap; until it lands, other epics' land agents cannot get a green 'just check' and have to triage these 63 by hand.

Moved src/sase/tasks to src/sase/procs (git mv), renamed BackgroundTask->Proc/task_id->proc_id and all facade symbols throughout, added src/sase/procs/_migration.py for the marker-guarded on-disk tasks->procs migration (with a running-proc symlink for live log writers), renamed the config key to procs.history_limit with tasks.history_limit as a deprecated legacy alias, updated tools/validate_sase_core_rs and all call sites (bead, main, ace/tui, monitor docstrings). PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: the legacy `tasks.history_limit` config key is parsed but never applied, so the plan requirement "legacy key still honored" is unmet. Root cause: src/sase/default_config.yml always ships `procs.history_limit: 100`, so get_proc_history_limit() (src/sase/config/core.py:328) always takes its first branch and the `tasks` fallback is dead code. Repro: a user config containing only `tasks: {history_limit: 5}` yields 100; the same file with `procs: {history_limit: 7}` yields 7. The deprecation *diagnostic* does work (the user layer reports deprecated_keys=["tasks"], so `sase config layers` / `sase doctor` nudge correctly) - only the value is ignored. Two candidate fixes, both needing an owner decision: (a) make the lookup layer-aware so a user-set legacy key outranks the bundled default but a user-set canonical key still wins, or (b) drop `history_limit` from the bundled default_config.yml and let DEFAULT_PROC_HISTORY_LIMIT be the only default, at the cost of config discoverability. Not fixed in the land phase because the precedence semantics are a design choice.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: homes already migrated by the shipped migration need a repair pass. The land phase fixed _relocate_legacy_logs so future migrations merge legacy logs into an existing ~/.sase/procs/logs, but the marker is one-shot, so a home migrated before the fix keeps its damage. Observed on this real home: ~/.sase/procs_migration.json says {schema_version: 1, completed: true, migrated: true}, yet 12 of 13 rows in procs.jsonl have a log_path under ~/.sase/procs/logs that does not exist, while ~/.sase/tasks/logs still holds 14883 un-relocated files (two of them the missing logs). Separately, stale-Python workspaces recreated ~/.sase/tasks/tasks.jsonl after the marker was written; it now holds 6 proc_id-keyed rows, one still status=running, which the new code cannot see and the one-shot migration will never adopt. A repair needs both a MIGRATION_SCHEMA_VERSION bump (so _marker_is_complete goes stale and the migration re-runs) and a change to the `new_store.exists()` guard in _migrate_legacy_store, which currently short-circuits to migrated=False and would strand those rows on a re-run.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: `just check-full` fails on the `flake baseline` gate (`tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake`), and it is host-wide flake debt, not a sase-lh regression. The gate reports 12 reproducible flake(s) exceeding tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt (window: records after 2026-08-10T23:36:35Z, <=5 failures/run): 2 nodes in tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_panel_header.py, tests/main/test_project_handler_list_show.py::TestListAndShow::test_project_handler_imports_in_fresh_interpreter, tests/monitor/test_monitor_start.py::test_start_monitor_promotes_a_bare_lane_and_runs_to_completion, tests/test_agent_artifact_marker_path_passing_audit.py::test_tracked_marker_path_passing_sites_are_reviewed, tests/test_axe_run_agent_runner_deferred_workspace_outcomes.py::TestDeferredWorkspaceOutcomes::test_repeat_stop_exits_before_workspace_claim_and_run_loop, tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection, and 5 nodes in tests/test_core_vcs_log.py. Evidence that this is not ours: (1) all 54 tests in those 8 files pass in this tree (uncommitted land-phase changes included), 33.7s, run serially with -p no:randomly; (2) the charging full-run records come from other workspaces on this host between 2026-08-11 and 2026-08-14 (heads 093088abb9ed, c1970b5a0b82, 4d36d6d3d663, 3085a0d287ad, d04e8cfcccef, 829030f97434, bd6167875cc8, 7e4ac6d7cdfa, db338f2ef7ab, 0620f71a0aee, b3057a618e7f, 48617f3eec9d, 9f93c3d8c0c5, e5aed16e766b, 9b5bff5bd310) with change sets in llm_provider, artifact_providers, monitor, docs, and CI config - none touching procs; (3) this land phase own full-suite record is clean: store record 20260814T034819Z-e9941fd9c289-1498866-full-run.json, mode=cost, exit_status=0, failures=[]. One caveat for the owner: the sase-lh epic did contribute one charging record, 20260814T005249Z-62fb94129662 (the phase-6 commit 62fb94129662 refactor(procs): move sase.tasks to sase.procs, now an ancestor of HEAD), which recorded a single failure of test_repeat_stop_exits_before_workspace_claim_and_run_loop. That node already had two in-window failures on 2026-08-12 in unrelated workspaces; those two shared mkdocs-pdf.yml, so the intersection test spared them, and our disjoint third observation is what tipped it over. The test is in the axe run-agent runner and is unrelated to procs, and it passes here. Resolution needs an owner decision and is out of scope for this phase: either fix the 12 nodes or file a bead per node and extend tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt (the file own policy requires a filed bead naming flake, evidence, and owner for each addition), or move the effective-after cutoff. Until then `just check-full` is red repo-wide for every agent, independent of this epic.

GREEN: fmt (python), fmt (markdown), lint (keep-sorted), lint (ruff), lint (mypy), lint (pyscripts), lint (test waits), lint (changelog), lint (patch/stitch terminology), lint (symvision), lint (toobig), SASE validation, committed plans, and `test cost` - which is the full fast suite lane (tools/run_pytest cost) and recorded exit_status=0 with zero failures. RED: only the final `flake baseline` gate, triaged in the note above as unrelated host-wide flake debt. Independently re-confirmed in this tree during triage: tools/validate_sase_core_rs exits 0 against the locally built sase_core_rs 0.27.1; sase-core has a clean working tree with HEAD == origin/master at db31de2 (chore: release v0.27.1) and c69a2f8 (feat(core)!: rename background task core to procs) contained in origin/master; `sase task list --json` (legacy alias) and `sase proc list --json` both exit 0 with the same schema_version 1 envelope; residue sweeps still clean - remaining `task_id` hits are bead work IDs, the Muse provider event field, and TUI detail-row parameters, remaining `tasks` hits are the deliberate legacy read fallback (procs/models.py, procs/_migration.py), the config legacy aliases (config/layers.py, config_center_state.py), and command-palette IDs, and remaining "background task" prose is the axe-spawned-agent docstring, the agy provider message, external-tool text in docs/llms.md, the intended glossary aliases in sase/sase.yml, and historical research notes under sase/repos/research/. NOT DONE: the working tree is still uncommitted (about 50 prose renames, the _relocate_legacy_logs fix in src/sase/procs/_migration.py, new tests in tests/test_procs_migration.py, and a reviewed-site entry in tests/test_agent_artifact_directory_operation_audit.py). This phase is therefore not closed - it cannot land while the change is uncommitted, and the tasks.history_limit precedence question recorded above still needs an owner decision.
